text: 金十数据10月9日讯，商务部发布中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会联合声明。双方将继续探讨在世贸组织规则框架下，降低部分商品关税的可能性。双方将继续在贸易监测机制项下加强沟通合作，并进一步积极发挥对话机制作用，增进相互理解。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 9 - The Ministry of Commerce issued a joint statement of the second regular meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism. The two sides will continue to explore the possibility of reducing tariffs on some goods within the framework of WTO rules. The two sides will continue to strengthen communication and cooperation under the trade monitoring mechanism and further actively leverage the role of the dialogue mechanism to enhance mutual understanding.
